lessons: In `_review_seeds`, first skip any worktree `tickets/<s>/ticket.md` whose blob SHA equals main's, unless it is one of this stem's journaled seeds. Only untracked files or files that differ from main are candidates. Classify existing-on-main only after this filter.

Add a test where main already holds an unrelated committed ticket (and the seeding ticket's own ticket.md). A seeding run must still pass Check, review only its new seeds, and send exactly one requisition request per new seed.

Keep the RE-RUN rule. Skip an identical own seed only when the journal has `ticket_intake` with `seeded_by == <stem>`. A foreign stem whose bytes differ from main must still fail with `requisition_review`.
Seed the fixture repos in test_seed_path/test_stages with several existing tickets on main. That way the candidate filter is exercised under realistic repo state, not only in an empty tickets/ plane.
